messages:
Maria: Heads up — firmware-staging job fw-stg-4567 started in apac and we're seeing the OOB/proxy path backlog cause GPU provisioning waitlist to jump from ~120 to ~360 in the last 12m. CI containers timing out. Metrics snapshot: waitlist +240, avg provision latency p50 18s -> 52s, bmc_heartbeat_failures +1.8k.

Jared: Which pools/racks are hit and is this correlated with the new BMC image? job id?

Maria: job id = fw-stg-4567. Impacted pools: apac-gpu-pool-a (r22-r27), apac-gpu-pool-b (r30-r33). Staging changed BMC keepalive (30s -> 120s) which increases concurrent mgmt sessions during flash/reboot. Quick check I ran: `redwoodctl fleet metrics --pool apac-gpu-pool-a --last 15m | grep -E 'waitlist|bmc_heartbeat|proxy'`

```
apac-gpu-pool-a waitlist 120 -> 360
apac-gpu-pool-a provision_latency_ms p50 18000 -> 52000
bmc_heartbeat_failures 0 -> 1823
proxy_conn_errors 12 -> 980
```

Anu: That proxy_conn_errors number matches the apac-jumphost conntrack/conn-limit behavior. The new image opens more concurrent management sessions during reboots/flash which thrashes the jumphost pool. Ops Bot started the rollout with parallelism=200 — too aggressive given current jumphost headroom.

Ben (oncall): Pause the rollout now. I'll reduce parallelism and trigger a canary rollback on r22 only. Also set autoscaler throttle so we don't spin up a ton of reserved nodes while this resolves.

Ops Bot: rollout fw-stg-4567 initiated by Maria at 5743210000; parallelism=200. Pausing rollout per request from Ben (oncall).

Maria: Paused. Initiating targeted rollback for r23-r27. Running recovery script: `scripts/bmc-reset-session.sh --rack r23-r27` (script will sleep 1s between nodes).

Kevin: FYI we've already seen an infra cost bump (~+18% last 30m) due to autoscaler reactions and warm node churn. Recommend temporary routing fallback and a brief cap on scale-ups: `redwoodctl routing set-policy --region apac --fallback=lower_tier` and `redwoodctl autoscaler set --region apac --max_scale_up_rate 1`.

Jared: After rollback we should: 1) change staging config to parallelism=16, 2) add a preflight check that proxies/jumphosts have `proxy_conn_errors < 50`, 3) increase jumphost ASG desired capacity by +1 for the next run.

Maria: Agreed. Action items: 
- rollback r23-r27 (in progress)
- autoscaler throttle applied for 20m (Ben)
- create postmortem ticket OWNER=maria TAGS=[firmware,apac,infra] and attach logs/metrics

Ben (oncall): Confirmed rollback started. If bmc_heartbeat_failures don't drop below 100 within 15m we'll escalate to networking to bump conntrack/timeouts on apac-proxy-# nodes. Please react with :thumbsup: when you see the metric dip.

Maria: Noted — updating ticket and will paste the final metric snapshot here. Thanks all.
